summary: In the functional and technical design meeting, the team revised the target demographic to younger customers under forty. The team agreed on a modern, mobile-phone-inspired aesthetic featuring backlit buttons that illuminate for 20 seconds during use, a see-through multi-colored casing (inspired by iMac/iPod), and a simplified single-level button layout with an indicator LED. A proposal for speech recognition was formally rejected due to multilingual complexity and technical feasibility. The team recessed for lunch, with Marketing continuing trendwatching research.
decisions: Pivoted target demographic from 40+ to consumers younger than 40 years old
Adopted backlit keypad illumination that activates on button press for 20 seconds to save battery
Approved a see-through multi-colour casing option inspired by iMac and iPod aesthetics
Selected a single-level standardized button layout with an activity indicator LED
Formally rejected speech recognition due to multilingual complexity and lack of necessity

action_items.task: Conduct trendwatching research on youthful design aesthetics during lunch recess
